revised.check_junction: the anchor reason assertions now name their segment. Every anchor reason used to be exported unqualified -- the V and the J both said reference_anchor_unresolved, anchor_removed, anchor_residue_rejected -- so a record carrying one did not say which anchor to look at. The spellings are now <segment>_<reason>. Each assertion here was retargeted to the segment its own fixture exercises, read from the failure rather than blanket-prefixed; none was weakened, and the parametrized one is stronger because it now asserts the segment it was given.

revised.disagreements: comment and docstring only, naming the segment-qualified reasons. The junction oracle's prose cited reference_anchor_unresolved and anchor_removed, the spellings this branch replaced with <segment>_<reason>. No comparison, tolerance or branch in the oracle changed -- it does not read the reasons list at all; the strings appear only in the explanation of why a null junction window is an identity rather than a skip.
revised.MECHANISMS: the assay.ambiguous_calls row lost its truth_gap and gained n_ambiguous_bases in truth_fields, because the count is now exported. The catalogue enforces field ownership at collection, so this row had to change before any test could declare the field. No other row was touched and no mechanism was added or removed.
revised.test_the_coverage_report_numbers_are_pin: the coverage pin moved assay.ambiguous_calls from gap-limited to verified, and the distribution from 20 verified / 5 gap-limited to 21 / 4. The row moved because the gap closed -- n_ambiguous_bases is exported -- which is the first row on this branch to move by the truth arriving rather than by a test being registered. The narrative docstring gained a paragraph saying so and the realized-not-requested semantics. The pin is strictly as strong: still per mechanism, still 31 rows, still asserting the distribution alongside, so a swap cannot hide in it.
revised.test_a_truth_gap_stays_visible_even_when: docstring only; the assertion is unchanged and still iterates every mechanism declaring a truth gap. The worked example named assay.ambiguous_calls as the live case of a mechanism verified on a borrowed field while its own truth went unexported. That is no longer true of it, so the example was retargeted to junction.n_addition, which is still in exactly that state: the junction bases are checkable against the sequence but the record does not say how many TdT added. An example has to be a mechanism that is still in the state being described.
revised.untemplated_runs: classification substrate changed from letter case to the engine's per-base flags, newly exposed as p_nucleotide_mask and tdt_addition_mask. The run splitting is unchanged and still delegates to provenance.untemplated_runs; only the P/N/mixed label is derived differently. Strictly stronger, and measurably so: over 200 human IGH records the case version reported 382 pure-N runs on recombine() alone but 328 N and 54 mixed once sequencing_errors(count=8) was added, inventing palindromes the recombination never wrote. The flag version reports 382 N in all three configurations tested, including under hypermutation. An oracle whose answer moves because a later pass rewrote the display encoding was reporting the encoding, not the provenance.
revised.REPORTS: one key renamed, split_by_case -> split_by_origin, following the function. The registry maps every public function in the module to the identities it can report disagreements on; this entry is () in both versions because the function supplies material to another comparison rather than reporting one itself. No identity was added, removed or retargeted.

test_the_reason_counts_one_unresolved_an.why: the pin recorded the limitation this branch removes. It asserted that reference_anchor_unresolved appears once per unresolved anchor and stated, in its docstring, that the record does NOT say which anchor -- the count was information and the attribution was missing. The successor asserts the attribution: the set of segments the reasons name equals the set whose allele is unresolved, and the unqualified spelling is gone from the vocabulary. Same records, same 200-record draw, strictly more pinned.

test_the_pass_with_no_counter_of_its_own.why: the predecessor asserted that ambiguous_base_calls moves no counter at all, because assay.ambiguous_calls declared a truth gap: the masking count lived in the trace as corrupt.ns.count and nowhere in the record. Its own failure message instructed this change -- 'assay.ambiguous_calls no longer declares a truth gap, so its count may now be exported -- in which case this test should check it moves'. n_ambiguous_bases is now exported, so the successor asserts the positive: exactly n_ambiguous_bases moves and no other owned counter, and its value equals the number of positions that actually differ from the unmasked run on the same seed. Strictly more pinned -- the predecessor could not distinguish a correct zero from a counter that had stopped reporting.

split_by_case.why: same partition, honest substrate. The predecessor split an untemplated run into its P and N parts by letter case, which is the convention at the moment the recombination writes a base and not afterwards: sequencing_errors lowercases what it corrupts and hypermutation writes uppercase, so case stops naming the origin as soon as either runs. The successor reads the engine's p_nucleotide_mask. It takes the simulation as a parameter because the answer lives there rather than in the run's bytes, and it is renamed because a function called split_by_case that no longer splits by case is a trap for the next reader. Nothing outside this module's own REPORTS registry called it.
